title: 一起轻轻热身
description: 两位成人在空区做不同的轻缓热身，留足行动空间。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults warm up in a spacious clear exercise area, the nearer one making a gentle shoulder circle and the farther one taking easy marching steps. Give them ample room and keep both fully on the floor in trainers. A rolled mat, simple water bottle, and empty low climbing wall establish the activity without clutter. Compose the movements as a single friendly everyday scene, avoiding mirrored poses or an instructional multi-panel arrangement. Use a painterly oil-pastel illustration with broken strokes, strong volume, a dusty pink and petrol-blue palette, and inviting natural light. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
